summary: US CENTCOM launched a new wave of strikes against Iranian targets for the ninth consecutive night, hitting multiple Iranian cities including Dasht Azadegan, Tabriz, Bandar Abbas, Chabahar, Mahshahr, Sirik, Konarak, Jask, Khorramshahr, Khorramabad and Sarbandar. Israeli forces struck and destroyed Hamas terror infrastructure in the Gaza Strip overnight including a weapons warehouse, weapons manufacturing site and launch site. Air defense systems in Kuwait are operating to intercept drone attacks from Iran as explosions were reported in Kuwait and multiple Iranian provinces.
key_points: US CENTCOM launched a new wave of attacks against Iran for the ninth consecutive night to degrade Iranian military capabilities used against commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @VahidOnline/77287).

Israeli forces attacked and destroyed Hamas terror infrastructure in several areas of the Gaza Strip overnight including a weapons warehouse, weapons manufacturing site and launch site (Source: @idf_telegram/24672).
Kuwaiti air defense systems are operating to intercept a drone attack from Iran and a drone fell on Kuwait's main power station (Source: @asafroz/51654).
Explosions were reported in Tabriz at 2:37-2:38 AM with multiple consecutive blasts heard across the city (Source: @VahidOnline/77284).
Two tankers attempting to move through an unsafe passage south of the Hormuz Strait exploded and were prevented from moving per IRGC (Source: @presstv/199479).
Israeli and Jordanian forces intercepted Iranian ballistic missiles launched toward Aqaba, Jordan, with possible spillover into Israeli territory (Source: @manniefabian/58806).
The IDF placed a submarine and Sa'ar-class ships on alert in the Eilat area toward the Red Sea amid multi-arena readiness (Source: @pkpoi/143348).
Two US soldiers were killed and one went missing in Jordan on July 17 with human remains found; a separate US soldier was killed in northern Iraq on July 18 (Source: @VahidOnline/77281).

sections.executive_summary: US CENTCOM launched a new wave of strikes against Iranian targets for the ninth consecutive night, hitting cities including Tabriz, Bandar Abbas, Chabahar and Mahshahr. Israeli forces destroyed Hamas terror infrastructure in the Gaza Strip overnight including a weapons warehouse and launch site. Kuwaiti air defenses are intercepting Iranian drone attacks as explosions spread across the region from Iran to the Red Sea.

points: The Atomic Energy Organization of Iran claims US forces attacked a nuclear power station under construction in the city of Darkhoveyn in Khuzestan Province overnight; the IAEA stated the plant is at very early construction stages with no nuclear material present and likely no radiological risk (Source: @asafroz/51649).

CENTCOM announced it launched a new wave of attacks against Iran for the ninth consecutive night to further degrade Iranian military capabilities used to attack commercial ships and civilians transiting the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @VahidOnline/77287).

Cities reported hit by US airstrikes include Dasht Azadegan, Tabriz, Bandar Abbas, Chabahar, Mahshahr, Sirik, Konarak, Jask, Khorramshahr, Khorramabad and Sarbandar; Tabriz residents reported multiple consecutive explosions at 2:37-2:38 AM (Source: @rodast_omiddana/76936).

Explosions were reported in Bushehr, Ilam and Baluchistan provinces; two explosions occurred in Mahshahr in Khuzestan Province and a new blast in Chabahar in Sistan and Balouchestan Province (Source: @New_security8200/202779).

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that an intelligence breach likely still unresolved allowed the enemy to know of meetings during the opening of the war aimed at assassinating Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei (Source: @asafroz/51645).

The IRGC stated two tankers violating instructions under US incitement exploded south of the Hormuz Strait and were stopped; it warned the US military to prepare for a punitive operation (Source: @naya_foriraq/84335).

The IDF attacked and destroyed Hamas terror infrastructure in several areas of the Gaza Strip overnight including a weapons warehouse, weapons manufacturing site and launch site; Southern Command forces remain deployed per agreement (Source: @idf_telegram/24672).
The IDF placed a submarine and Sa'ar-class ships on alert in the Eilat area toward the Red Sea amid multi-arena readiness; a interception occurred in the skies over Eilat (Source: @pkpoi/143348).

The IDF detected ballistic missiles launched from Iran toward Aqaba, Jordan, warning of possible spillover into Israeli territory with sirens if needed; Israeli and Jordanian forces intercepted the projectiles (Source: @manniefabian/58806).

The Chief of Staff stated the IDF is monitoring Iran and prepared for immediate return to combat; a false identification triggered alerts in Kfar Aza and Sa'ad that were later cleared (Source: @pkpoi/143352).

A security source told Al-Hadath that Washington does not want Israel participating in operations against Iran even if Iran attacks Israel, and that Iran planned to assassinate figures in Tel Aviv in revenge for Khamenei's elimination (Source: @pkpoi/143333).
Defense Minister Katz ordered the IDF Chief of Staff to ensure Omri Ronen, who called for political refusal, be removed from any IDF service framework (Source: @inon_yttach/9526).

The IDF attacked and destroyed Hamas terror infrastructure in several areas of the Gaza Strip overnight including a weapons warehouse, weapons manufacturing site and launch site intended to hit IDF forces in the yellow line area and Israeli civilians (Source: @idf_telegram/24672).

Following alerts activated shortly before in the Kfar Aza and Sa'ad areas, the IDF stated it was a false identification; the event ended and residents could leave protected spaces (Source: @idf_telegram/24675).
The Red Alert event in Kfar Aza and Sa'ad ended at 03:01 on 20/07/2026 per security channel reporting (Source: @New_security8200/202788).
A Palestinian man, Hamada al-Banna, who was presumed dead, reunited with his family in Gaza City per Press TV reporting (Source: @presstv/199470).

No additional specific operational details regarding West Bank activities were explicitly stated in the provided messages beyond the Gaza Strip engagements described above (Source: @idf_telegram/24672).
The US Secretary of State met with the President of Lebanon in Washington per AFP reporting cited by Yediot (Source: @yediotnews25/132886).
Map posts referenced locations including Al-Sawana, Iskandarouna and Fawq Al-Sawana with alert markers but no explicit operational combat details were stated (Source: @redlinkleb/32030).
A weather report was issued for Beirut Rafic Hariri Airport showing 29°C, 75% humidity and light westerly winds with no conflict-related content (Source: @redlinkleb/32046).
No explicit reports of Israeli strikes, Hezbollah engagements or casualty figures in Lebanon were stated in the provided messages beyond the above (Source: @yediotnews25/132886).

A US soldier was killed in northern Iraq on July 18 during a controlled detonation of unexploded ordnance from a downed Iranian suicide drone, with another soldier wounded and under medical treatment (Source: @VahidOnline/77281).

Two US soldiers were killed and one went missing in Jordan on July 17 following an Iranian attack; human remains were found at the location and identification is under review (Source: @asafroz/51652).

The Jordanian army stated it brought down three Iranian missiles that targeted its territory and one projectile was jointly intercepted by Israeli and Jordanian forces near Aqaba (Source: @VahidOnline/77278).
Jordan denied that Aqaba airport or seaport were evacuated per reporting from i24 (Source: @inon_yttach/9525).
No explicit details on Syria-specific operations or casualties were stated in the provided messages (Source: @VahidOnline/77281).
Kuwaiti air defense systems are operating to intercept a drone attack from Iran; a drone fell on Kuwait's main power station and explosions were heard in Kuwait (Source: @asafroz/51654).
The British military reported a fire aboard a ship in the Strait of Hormuz per Iraqi channel reporting (Source: @naya_foriraq/84331).

The IRGC stated two tankers exploded south of the Hormuz Strait after violating instructions under US incitement, preventing their movement and warning of a punitive operation (Source: @presstv/199479).
The IDF placed a submarine and Sa'ar-class ships on alert in the Eilat area toward the Red Sea and an interception occurred over Eilat (Source: @inon_yttach/9529).
Jordan intercepted three Iranian missiles targeting its territory and denied evacuation of Aqaba port or airport (Source: @inon_yttach/9525).

sections.threat_assessment: The operational picture shows a major US-led escalation against Iran with strikes across at least eleven Iranian cities including Tabriz, Bandar Abbas and Chabahar for the ninth consecutive night, indicating sustained offensive tempo. Iranian retaliation via drones and ballistic missiles toward Jordan and Kuwait demonstrates cross-border spillover risk into Israeli territory near Eilat where interceptions occurred. The IRGC's warning of a punitive operation after tanker explosions south of Hormuz raises the prospect of further maritime disruption in the Strait of Hormuz. An unresolved Iranian intelligence breach cited by Foreign Minister Araghchi suggests continued vulnerability of Iranian leadership to targeted action.
sections.regional_response: Kuwait activated air defenses to intercept Iranian drones and suffered a drone strike on its main power station, reflecting direct Gulf exposure to Iranian retaliation. Jordan intercepted three Iranian missiles and denied port evacuation, while coordinating with Israel on interception near Aqaba. The US maintains CENTCOM strikes while Washington reportedly does not want Israeli participation in operations against Iran per a security source. The British military reported a fire aboard a ship in the Hormuz Strait, indicating broader coalition maritime concern.
sections.intelligence_notes: A security source told Al-Hadath that Mojtaba Khamenei is not in Iran and messages attributed to him are drafted by Ahmad Vahidi and the IRGC, with deepening internal divisions threatening IRGC stability. The same source claimed Iran planned assassinations of figures in Tel Aviv in revenge for Ali Khamenei's elimination. The IDF Chief of Staff confirmed monitoring of Iran and readiness for immediate return to combat. False identifications in Kfar Aza and Sa'ad were cleared, showing alert system sensitivity amid multi-arena readiness including submarine and Sa'ar ships near Eilat.
